measurementNotes: Game and LoadClient ran on the same Windows machine. Tick execution includes movement, AOI, serialization and outbound enqueue; pending jobs are recorded separately.

window.runtime is the difference between the first and last server runtime samples (100ms interval) inside the client measurement window. CPU is the Game process total processor time; allocation is GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes.

Baseline: commit a365e41 plus runtime instrumentation only (RuntimeMetrics, socket write counter). One socket write per packet; per-tick collections and per-packet temporary arrays. Median CPU run of three.
